name: all for Edel
source:
If you want to arrive in the Land of the Dead, you must first walk through all the seasons of life. Weiss needs only to come out of Winter to finally reunite with their love, Edel, but the snow-covered land always hungers for life. After the generosity that other seasons provided comes time to repay...

[From [url=https://naarel.itch.io/all-for-edel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果你想到达亡灵之地，你必须先走过人生的所有季节。韦斯只需走出冬天，就能最终与他们的爱人埃德尔团聚，但冰雪覆盖的土地总是渴望生命。在其他季节提供的慷慨之后，是时候回报了……

[来自[url=https://naarel.itch.io/all-for-edel]itch.io[/url]]
